about: What a deploy's owner approves (M218): the project, the environment (its id and its name, so the name a person reads is in the hashed bytes), the plan's SHA-256, the source, and the hash of the deploy's planned event in its environment's log, as a fixed text. Its hash is SHA-256 over exactly that text, hex: change any byte (another plan, commit, environment or log) and the approval no longer names it.

output.body:
arugula deploy op v1
project prj_1
environment env_1
name production
plan aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
source commit 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
where acme/app
planned abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab
